01-01.title: New Year
01-01.line: behold, I make all things new.
01-01.meaning: a fresh year, a fresh start. nothing is too worn out for God to renew.

01-02.title: Lamentations 3
01-02.line: his compassions fail not. They are new every morning.
01-02.meaning: whatever yesterday held, today's mercy is fresh.

01-03.title: Genesis 1
01-03.line: God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
01-03.meaning: the first words of creation. light is still God's first gift each morning.

01-04.title: Proverbs 3
01-04.line: trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
01-04.meaning: you don't have to figure it all out today.

01-05.title: Augustine
01-05.line: thou madest us for Thyself, and our heart is restless, until it repose in Thee.
01-05.meaning: that restless feeling isn't a flaw. it's a sign we were made for God.
01-05.source: Augustine, Confessions I.1 (tr. E. B. Pusey)

01-06.title: Epiphany
01-06.line: when they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
01-06.meaning: the wise men followed a light a long way. what light is leading you this year?

01-07.title: Psalm 23
01-07.line: the LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
01-07.meaning: the most loved line of the Psalms. you are being led and cared for.

01-08.title: Isaiah 40
01-08.line: they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength.
01-08.meaning: tired is okay. strength comes back.

01-09.title: John 1
01-09.line: the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
01-09.meaning: the dark never gets the last word.

01-10.title: Psalm 46
01-10.line: be still, and know that I am God.
01-10.meaning: stillness isn't empty. it's where we notice God.

01-11.title: Amazing Grace
01-11.line: I once was lost, but now am found, was blind, but now I see.
01-11.meaning: John Newton, a former slave-ship captain, wrote this about his own change of heart. no one is past grace.

01-12.title: Micah 6
01-12.line: to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.
01-12.meaning: three simple things: be fair, be kind, walk with God.

01-13.title: Philippians 4
01-13.line: be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving.
01-13.meaning: 'careful' here means anxious. hand your worries over, with thanks.

01-14.title: Philippians 4
01-14.line: the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts.
01-14.meaning: a peace that doesn't need everything to make sense first.

01-15.title: Matthew 5
01-15.line: ye are the light of the world.
01-15.meaning: you, today, just as you are.

01-16.title: Psalm 121
01-16.line: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
01-16.meaning: look up today. help is near.

01-17.title: John 14
01-17.line: peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you.
01-17.meaning: Jesus said this the night before he died. peace is a gift you can receive.

01-18.title: Julian of Norwich
01-18.line: all shall be well, and all manner of thing shall be well.
01-18.meaning: a 14th-century anchoress heard these words in prayer. they've comforted people for 600 years.
01-18.source: Julian of Norwich, Revelations of Divine Love, ch. 27

01-19.title: Psalm 139
01-19.line: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
01-19.meaning: you were made with care. so was everyone you'll meet today.

01-20.title: Romans 8
01-20.line: all things work together for good to them that love God.
01-20.meaning: even the parts of today that don't make sense yet.

01-21.title: 1 John 4
01-21.line: we love him, because he first loved us.
01-21.meaning: love starts with being loved. you already are.

01-22.title: Joshua 1
01-22.line: be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed.
01-22.meaning: God goes with you into whatever today holds.

01-23.title: Psalm 30
01-23.line: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

01-24.title: Galatians 5
01-24.line: the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith.
01-24.meaning: these grow slowly, like fruit. pick one to tend today.

01-25.title: The Conversion of Paul
01-25.line: Lord, what wilt thou have me to do?
01-25.meaning: Paul's whole life turned on one honest question. a good one to start a day with.

01-26.title: It Is Well
01-26.line: it is well, it is well with my soul.
01-26.meaning: Horatio Spafford wrote this after losing his four daughters at sea. peace can live under great grief.
01-26.source: Horatio Spafford, It Is Well with My Soul (1873)

01-27.title: Isaiah 41
01-27.line: fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God.
01-27.meaning: two reasons not to fear: God is with you, and God is yours.

01-28.title: Matthew 6
01-28.line: take therefore no thought for the morrow.
01-28.meaning: today has enough in it. tomorrow can wait.

01-29.title: Psalm 19
01-29.line: the heavens declare the glory of God.
01-29.meaning: look up tonight. the whole sky is singing.

01-30.title: 2 Corinthians 5
01-30.line: if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature.
01-30.meaning: your past doesn't get the final say.

01-31.title: John 8
01-31.line: I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness.
01-31.meaning: even dim days have light in them.

02-01.title: Brother Lawrence
02-01.line: the time of business does not with me differ from the time of prayer.
02-01.meaning: a monastery cook who prayed among the pots and pans. your chores can be prayer too.
02-01.source: Brother Lawrence, The Practice of the Presence of God, Fourth Conversation

02-02.title: The Presentation of Jesus (Candlemas)
02-02.line: a light to lighten the Gentiles.
02-02.meaning: old Simeon waited his whole life to hold this child. some prayers take years, and still come true.

02-03.title: Psalm 34
02-03.line: O taste and see that the LORD is good.
02-03.meaning: faith isn't only an idea. it can be tasted and enjoyed.

02-04.title: Hebrews 13
02-04.line: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

02-05.title: Ecclesiastes 3
02-05.line: to every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven.
02-05.meaning: if today is a waiting season, it's still a season.

02-06.title: Matthew 7
02-06.line: ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find.
02-06.meaning: God likes being asked. ask today.

02-07.title: Psalm 46
02-07.line: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
02-07.meaning: 'very present' means right here, right now.

02-08.title: 1 Peter 5
02-08.line: casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

02-09.title: John 15
02-09.line: I am the vine, ye are the branches.
02-09.meaning: stay connected, and growth comes on its own.

02-10.title: Be Thou My Vision
02-10.line: be thou my vision, O Lord of my heart.
02-10.meaning: an old Irish prayer, later a beloved hymn. let God be what you look toward today.
02-10.source: Be Thou My Vision, Old Irish (tr. Mary Byrne, 1905; versified Eleanor Hull, 1912)

02-11.title: Psalm 37
02-11.line: delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
02-11.meaning: start with delight. the rest follows.

02-12.title: Romans 12
02-12.line: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer.
02-12.meaning: hope, patience, prayer: a simple rhythm for a hard week.

02-13.title: Psalm 55
02-13.line: cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee.
02-13.meaning: you don't have to carry it alone.

02-14.title: 1 Corinthians 13
02-14.line: charity suffereth long, and is kind.
02-14.meaning: on a day for love, here is the oldest definition: patient and kind. 'charity' is the old word for love.

02-15.title: Luke 1
02-15.line: with God nothing shall be impossible.
02-15.meaning: whatever feels stuck today, God isn't stuck.

02-16.title: Colossians 3
02-16.line: whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord.
02-16.meaning: ordinary work done with heart is worship.

02-17.title: Isaiah 26
02-17.line: thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee.
02-17.meaning: where you rest your mind matters.

02-18.title: Psalm 27
02-18.line: the LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
02-18.meaning: light in the dark. carry it today.

02-19.title: C. S. Lewis
02-19.line: act as if you love your neighbour, and love often follows.
02-19.meaning: Lewis noticed that acting in love often grows the feeling. try one kind act today.
02-19.source: after C. S. Lewis, Mere Christianity, Book III, ch. 9 (paraphrase)

02-20.title: Matthew 5
02-20.line: blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

02-21.title: James 1
02-21.line: every good gift and every perfect gift is from above.
02-21.meaning: notice one good gift today. say thanks.

02-22.title: Psalm 90
02-22.line: so teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
02-22.meaning: each day counts. this one too.

02-23.title: John 13
02-23.line: a new commandment I give unto you, That ye love one another.
02-23.meaning: the whole Gospel in one line.

02-24.title: Isaiah 43
02-24.line: behold, I will do a new thing.
02-24.meaning: God isn't done. something new can grow here.

02-25.title: Ephesians 4
02-25.line: be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another.
02-25.meaning: kind, tender, forgiving. one moment at a time.

02-26.title: Psalm 16
02-26.line: in thy presence is fulness of joy.
02-26.meaning: joy isn't found far away. it's in being near.

02-27.title: Abide with Me
02-27.line: abide with me; fast falls the eventide.
02-27.meaning: Henry Lyte wrote this near the end of his life. a prayer for evenings and for hard days.
02-27.source: Henry Francis Lyte, Abide with Me (1847)

02-28.title: Mark 4
02-28.meaning: Jesus said it to the storm. say it to yours.

02-29.title: Matthew 6
02-29.line: consider the lilies of the field, how they grow.
02-29.meaning: flowers don't worry, and they're cared for. so are you.

03-01.title: Luke 6
03-01.line: give, and it shall be given unto you.
03-01.meaning: generosity has a way of coming back.

03-02.title: Romans 15
03-02.line: the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing.

03-03.title: Thomas à Kempis
03-03.line: keep peace in yourself first, and you can bring peace to others.
03-03.meaning: peace starts inside and spreads out.
03-03.source: after Thomas à Kempis, The Imitation of Christ II.3 (paraphrase)

03-04.title: Psalm 51
03-04.line: create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
03-04.meaning: a fresh start is always available.

03-05.title: John 3
03-05.line: for God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
03-05.meaning: the most famous verse in the Bible begins with love.

03-06.title: Proverbs 15
03-06.line: a soft answer turneth away wrath.
03-06.meaning: a gentle word can cool a hot moment.

03-07.title: Hebrews 11
03-07.line: faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

03-08.title: Psalm 23
03-08.line: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

03-09.title: Isaiah 30
03-09.line: in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength.
03-09.meaning: quiet trust is a kind of strength.

03-10.title: Come Thou Fount
03-10.line: come, thou Fount of every blessing, tune my heart to sing thy grace.
03-10.meaning: Robert Robinson wrote this at 22. let your heart be tuned today.
03-10.source: Robert Robinson, Come Thou Fount of Every Blessing (1758)

03-11.title: 1 Thessalonians 5
03-11.meaning: two words. the shortest verse in the Greek New Testament.

03-12.title: 1 Thessalonians 5
03-12.meaning: not constant words. a heart turned toward God, all day.

03-13.title: 1 Thessalonians 5
03-13.meaning: not for everything, but in everything. look for one thanks today.

03-14.title: Psalm 4
03-14.line: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep.
03-14.meaning: a line for tonight. you can let today go.

03-15.title: John 10
03-15.line: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.
03-15.meaning: God wants more life for you, not less.

03-16.title: Galatians 6
03-16.meaning: who could use a hand today?

03-17.title: St. Patrick
03-17.line: Christ with me, Christ before me, Christ behind me.
03-17.meaning: Patrick went back to Ireland, where he had once been a captive, to share the faith. say this line as you head out.
03-17.source: St. Patrick's Breastplate (Lorica), traditional (tr. Kuno Meyer)

03-18.title: Psalm 34
03-18.line: the LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart.
03-18.meaning: if you're hurting, God is close.

03-19.title: Dietrich Bonhoeffer
03-19.line: the first service we owe others is to listen to them.
03-19.meaning: Bonhoeffer wrote this about life in community. listen first today.
03-19.source: after Dietrich Bonhoeffer, Life Together, ch. 4 (paraphrase)

03-20.title: Romans 8
03-20.line: neither death, nor life... shall be able to separate us from the love of God.

03-21.title: Psalm 100
03-21.line: make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

03-22.title: Matthew 5
03-22.line: blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
03-22.meaning: if you feel empty, you're closer than you think.

03-23.title: Proverbs 16
03-23.line: a man's heart deviseth his way: but the LORD directeth his steps.
03-23.meaning: make your plans, and hold them lightly.

03-24.title: Isaiah 43
03-24.line: when thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee.
03-24.meaning: not around the waters: through them, together.

03-25.title: The Annunciation
03-25.line: be it unto me according to thy word.
03-25.meaning: Mary's yes changed everything. what small yes could you say today?

03-26.title: James 1
03-26.line: let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.

03-27.title: Psalm 62
03-27.line: truly my soul waiteth upon God.

03-28.title: Holy, Holy, Holy
03-28.line: early in the morning our song shall rise to thee.
03-28.meaning: Reginald Heber's hymn for Trinity Sunday. a good first thought for the day.

03-29.title: John 14
03-29.line: let not your heart be troubled: ye believe in God, believe also in me.
03-29.meaning: a gentle word for an anxious heart.

03-30.title: Luke 10
03-30.line: thou art careful and troubled about many things: But one thing is needful.
03-30.meaning: Martha was busy. Jesus invited her to sit.

03-31.title: Psalm 145
03-31.line: the LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him.

04-01.title: 1 Corinthians 13
04-01.line: now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

04-02.title: Deuteronomy 31
04-02.line: he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
04-02.meaning: a promise that holds on the hard days too.

04-03.title: Psalm 118
04-03.line: the LORD is on my side; I will not fear.

04-04.title: Matthew 6
04-04.line: where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
04-04.meaning: what we love most shapes us.

04-05.title: Ephesians 2
04-05.meaning: the word means something made with care. that's you.

04-06.title: George Herbert
04-06.line: teach me, my God and King, in all things thee to see.
04-06.meaning: a country parson-poet's prayer: find God in ordinary things.

04-07.title: Psalm 42
04-07.line: as the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee.
04-07.meaning: that thirst you feel is for God.

04-08.title: Romans 12
04-08.line: be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
04-08.meaning: answer one hard thing today with something good.

04-09.title: Psalm 121
04-09.line: the LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in.
04-09.meaning: a blessing for every door you walk through today.

04-10.title: Matthew 22
04-10.line: thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
04-10.meaning: as yourself: so be kind to yourself too.

04-11.title: Isaiah 55
04-11.line: all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
04-11.meaning: creation is cheering. listen to the trees.

04-12.title: Psalm 37
04-12.line: rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him.

04-13.title: Colossians 3
04-13.line: let the peace of God rule in your hearts... and be ye thankful.

04-14.title: Psalm 127
04-14.meaning: rest is a gift, not a reward to be earned.

04-15.title: Love Divine
04-15.line: love divine, all loves excelling, joy of heaven, to earth come down.
04-15.meaning: Charles Wesley wrote thousands of hymns. this one is a prayer for God's love to settle in us.
04-15.source: Charles Wesley, Love Divine, All Loves Excelling (1747)

04-16.title: John 6
04-16.line: I am the bread of life.

04-17.title: Psalm 143
04-17.line: cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust.
04-17.meaning: a good first prayer of the day.

04-18.title: Proverbs 17
04-18.line: a friend loveth at all times.

04-19.title: Psalm 147
04-19.line: he healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

04-20.title: 2 Corinthians 12
04-20.line: my grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

04-21.title: Psalm 119
04-21.line: thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
04-21.meaning: enough light for the next step.

04-22.title: Luke 2
04-22.line: Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
04-22.meaning: you don't have to understand everything right away. ponder.

04-23.title: Augustine
04-23.line: too late loved I Thee, O Thou Beauty of ancient days, yet ever new!
04-23.meaning: Augustine found that God had been with him all along. it's never too late.
04-23.source: Augustine, Confessions X.27 (tr. E. B. Pusey)

04-24.title: Psalm 133
04-24.line: behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
04-24.meaning: peace at home is a quiet miracle.

04-25.title: Mark 9
04-25.line: Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.
04-25.meaning: faith and doubt can sit together. that's an honest prayer.

04-26.title: Psalm 84
04-26.line: a day in thy courts is better than a thousand.
04-26.meaning: a little time with God is never wasted.

04-27.title: Matthew 5
04-27.line: let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works.
04-27.meaning: let your light show, not for you, but for others.

04-28.title: Zephaniah 3
04-28.line: he will rejoice over thee with joy... he will joy over thee with singing.
04-28.meaning: God isn't just patient with you. God sings over you.

04-29.title: Psalm 103
04-29.line: bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits.
04-29.meaning: remember three good things from this week.

04-30.title: What a Friend
04-30.line: what a friend we have in Jesus, all our sins and griefs to bear!
04-30.meaning: Joseph Scriven wrote this to comfort his mother far away. take it all to God in prayer.
04-30.source: Joseph Scriven, What a Friend We Have in Jesus (1855)

05-01.title: Psalm 56
05-01.line: what time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
05-01.meaning: fear and trust can happen in the same moment.

05-02.title: 1 John 4
05-02.line: there is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear.

05-03.title: Psalm 18
05-03.line: the LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer.

05-04.title: Matthew 19
05-04.line: with God all things are possible.

05-05.title: Psalm 25
05-05.line: shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

05-06.title: Romans 5
05-06.line: the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost.

05-07.title: Psalm 131
05-07.line: surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother.
05-07.meaning: rest like a child in a parent's lap.

05-08.title: John Donne
05-08.line: no man is an island, entire of itself.
05-08.meaning: we belong to each other. reach out to someone today.
05-08.source: John Donne, Devotions upon Emergent Occasions, Meditation XVII (1624)

05-09.title: John 11
05-09.meaning: the shortest verse. God weeps with us.

05-10.title: Psalm 65
05-10.line: thou crownest the year with thy goodness.
05-10.meaning: look for goodness in this year so far.

05-11.title: Philippians 4
05-11.line: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

05-12.title: Proverbs 18
05-12.line: the name of the LORD is a strong tower.
05-12.meaning: a safe place to run to.

05-13.title: Luke 17
05-13.line: the kingdom of God is within you.

05-14.title: Psalm 86
05-14.line: teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth.
05-14.meaning: learning and walking, one step at a time.

05-15.title: 1 Corinthians 16
05-15.line: let all your things be done with charity.

05-16.title: A Mighty Fortress
05-16.line: a mighty fortress is our God, a bulwark never failing.
05-16.meaning: Martin Luther's hymn, a song of courage for hard times.
05-16.source: Martin Luther, Ein feste Burg (tr. F. H. Hedge, 1853)

05-17.title: Psalm 92
05-17.line: it is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD.
05-17.meaning: thanks is good for the soul.

05-18.title: Matthew 5
05-18.line: blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see God.

05-19.title: Isaiah 40
05-19.line: the grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

05-20.title: John 14
05-20.line: in my Father's house are many mansions.

05-21.title: Psalm 61
05-21.line: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
05-21.meaning: when you feel overwhelmed, ask to be lifted.

05-22.title: Colossians 3
05-22.line: put on therefore... kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering.

05-23.title: Psalm 63
05-23.line: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee.
05-23.meaning: give God the first thought of the day.

05-24.title: John Wesley
05-24.line: I felt my heart strangely warmed.
05-24.meaning: on this day in 1738, at a meeting in London, Wesley found the faith he'd been preaching become his own.

05-25.title: Matthew 25
05-25.line: I was a stranger, and ye took me in.

05-26.title: Thomas à Kempis
05-26.meaning: make your plans gently. God holds the outcome.
05-26.source: Thomas à Kempis, The Imitation of Christ I.19

05-27.title: Psalm 104
05-27.line: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all.
05-27.meaning: notice the variety of life today.

05-28.title: 1 John 4
05-28.line: beloved, let us love one another: for love is of God.
05-28.meaning: every act of love comes from God.

05-29.title: Proverbs 4
05-29.line: keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
05-29.meaning: tend your heart. life flows from it.

05-30.title: Mark 6
05-30.line: come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while.
05-30.meaning: Jesus told his friends to rest. you can too.

05-31.title: Psalm 139
05-31.line: search me, O God, and know my heart.
05-31.meaning: an honest prayer. nothing to hide.

06-01.title: Romans 12
06-01.line: rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
06-01.meaning: being with people where they are is love.

06-02.title: For the Beauty of the Earth
06-02.line: for the beauty of the earth, for the glory of the skies.
06-02.meaning: a Victorian hymn of thanks for creation. take a short walk and notice the sky today.
06-02.source: Folliott S. Pierpoint, For the Beauty of the Earth (1864)

06-03.title: Psalm 8
06-03.line: what is man, that thou art mindful of him?
06-03.meaning: small under the stars, and still remembered.

06-04.title: John 16
06-04.line: be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.
06-04.meaning: the world is hard. it isn't the final word.

06-05.title: Isaiah 64
06-05.line: we are the clay, and thou our potter.

06-06.title: Psalm 37
06-06.line: commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him.

06-07.title: Hebrews 13
06-07.line: be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
06-07.meaning: be kind to the stranger. you never know.

06-08.title: Psalm 31
06-08.line: my times are in thy hand.

06-09.title: Luke 6
06-09.line: as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
06-09.meaning: the golden rule. simple and hard.

06-10.title: Peace Prayer
06-10.line: where there is hatred, let me sow love.
06-10.meaning: a prayer from about 1912, in the spirit of Francis of Assisi. where can you bring love today?

06-11.title: Psalm 145
06-11.line: the LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

06-12.title: 1 Corinthians 13
06-12.line: beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

06-13.title: Psalm 107
06-13.line: he maketh the storm a calm.

06-14.title: Matthew 14
06-14.line: be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
06-14.meaning: in the storm, he comes near.

06-15.title: Isaiah 54
06-15.line: the mountains shall depart... but my kindness shall not depart from thee.

06-16.title: Psalm 116
06-16.line: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice.

06-17.title: Ephesians 3
06-17.line: being rooted and grounded in love.

06-18.title: Blessed Assurance
06-18.line: this is my story, this is my song.
06-18.meaning: Fanny Crosby, blind from infancy, wrote thousands of hymns. your life is a song too.

06-19.title: Psalm 5
06-19.line: my voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD.

06-20.title: Luke 19
06-20.line: the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.
06-20.meaning: lost is not the end. it's where he looks.

06-21.title: James 4
06-21.line: draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.
06-21.meaning: one step toward God, and God steps closer.

06-22.title: Psalm 24
06-22.line: the earth is the LORD's, and the fulness thereof.
06-22.meaning: everything belongs to God. treat it gently.

06-23.title: Philippians 1
06-23.line: he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it.
06-23.meaning: God finishes what he starts. that includes you.

06-24.title: John the Baptist
06-24.line: he must increase, but I must decrease.
06-24.meaning: John pointed away from himself. there's freedom in not needing to be the center.

06-25.title: Ruth 1
06-25.line: whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge.
06-25.meaning: loyalty is a quiet kind of love.

06-26.title: Psalm 32
06-26.line: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go.
06-26.meaning: you're being taught as you go.

06-27.title: Matthew 11
06-27.line: I am meek and lowly in heart: and ye shall find rest unto your souls.
06-27.meaning: gentle and humble. that's who invites you.

06-28.title: Richard of Chichester
06-28.line: to know thee more clearly, love thee more dearly, follow thee more nearly.
06-28.meaning: a 13th-century bishop's prayer, three steps for any day.
06-28.source: after the prayer of St. Richard of Chichester (paraphrase)

06-29.title: Psalm 100
06-29.line: enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise.
06-29.meaning: start with thanks. it opens the door.

06-30.title: Romans 12
06-30.line: be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.

07-01.title: Psalm 23
07-01.meaning: rest and renewal are part of the path.

07-02.title: John 4
07-02.line: a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
07-02.meaning: a spring inside that doesn't run dry.

07-03.title: Proverbs 16
07-03.line: pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul.
07-03.meaning: say something sweet to someone today.

07-04.title: Psalm 139
07-04.line: if I take the wings of the morning... even there shall thy hand lead me.
07-04.meaning: no place is too far for God.

07-05.title: Matthew 6
07-05.line: behold the fowls of the air: for they sow not, neither do they reap.
07-05.meaning: the birds are fed. you are cared for.

07-06.title: Rock of Ages
07-06.line: rock of ages, cleft for me, let me hide myself in thee.
07-06.meaning: Augustus Toplady's hymn. a safe place, always.

07-07.title: Psalm 40
07-07.line: I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

07-08.title: Isaiah 61
07-08.line: he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted.
07-08.meaning: Jesus read this in the synagogue. it describes his work.

07-09.title: 1 John 1
07-09.line: God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

07-10.title: Psalm 73
07-10.line: God is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
07-10.meaning: when strength runs out, God doesn't.

07-11.title: Psalm 90
07-11.line: Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
07-11.meaning: a home that's always been there.

07-12.title: 2 Corinthians 4
07-12.line: though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

07-13.title: Augustine
07-13.line: love, and do what thou wilt.
07-13.meaning: if love is the root, the rest grows well.
07-13.source: Augustine, Homilies on the First Epistle of John 7.8

07-14.title: Psalm 127
07-14.line: except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it.
07-14.meaning: invite God into what you're building.

07-15.title: Matthew 7
07-15.line: a wise man, which built his house upon a rock.

07-16.title: Psalm 94
07-16.line: in the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
07-16.meaning: when thoughts crowd in, comfort is there too.

07-17.title: Ephesians 4
07-17.line: with all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love.
07-17.meaning: patience with each other is love in action.

07-18.title: Psalm 130
07-18.line: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

07-19.title: John 6
07-19.line: him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

07-20.title: Nearer, My God, to Thee
07-20.line: nearer, my God, to thee, nearer to thee.
07-20.meaning: Sarah Flower Adams based this on Jacob's dream of a ladder to heaven.
07-20.source: Sarah Flower Adams, Nearer, My God, to Thee (1841)

07-21.title: Genesis 28
07-21.line: surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
07-21.meaning: Jacob woke and realized God had been there all along.

07-22.title: Mary Magdalene
07-22.line: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord.
07-22.meaning: the first to meet the risen Jesus, and the first to tell the others. good news is meant to be shared.

07-23.title: Isaiah 40
07-23.line: he shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm.

07-24.title: Matthew 10
07-24.line: the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

07-25.title: Psalm 147
07-25.line: he telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
07-25.meaning: the One who names stars knows your name.

07-26.title: Acts 20
07-26.line: it is more blessed to give than to receive.

07-27.title: Psalm 34
07-27.line: I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
07-27.meaning: thanks in good times and hard ones.

07-28.title: Romans 8
07-28.line: if God be for us, who can be against us?
07-28.meaning: you are not alone in this.

07-29.title: Irish blessing
07-29.line: may the road rise to meet you, may the wind be always at your back.
07-29.meaning: a traditional Irish blessing. pass it on to someone today.

07-30.title: Psalm 119
07-30.line: open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.
07-30.meaning: ask to see something new today.

07-31.title: John 15
07-31.line: that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.

08-01.title: Psalm 40
08-01.line: he hath put a new song in my mouth.
08-01.meaning: there's a new song for you.

08-03.title: Psalm 17
08-03.line: keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of thy wings.

08-04.title: Mark 1
08-04.line: rising up a great while before day, he went out... and there prayed.
08-04.meaning: Jesus found quiet time early. find yours.

08-05.title: This Little Light of Mine
08-05.line: this little light of mine, I'm gonna let it shine.
08-05.meaning: a gospel song loved by children and grown-ups alike. let yours shine.
08-05.source: This Little Light of Mine, traditional gospel song

08-06.title: The Transfiguration
08-06.line: this is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.
08-06.meaning: on the mountain, the disciples were given a glimpse of glory before the hard road ahead. hold on to bright moments.

08-07.title: Luke 2
08-07.line: Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.
08-07.meaning: growing is part of the plan.

08-08.title: Proverbs 27
08-08.line: iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.

08-09.title: Psalm 36
08-09.line: in thy light shall we see light.
08-09.meaning: God's light helps us see everything else.

08-10.title: John 20
08-10.line: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.

08-11.title: Psalm 66
08-11.line: blessed be God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
08-11.meaning: your prayers are not turned away.

08-12.title: Hebrews 12
08-12.line: looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith.
08-12.meaning: keep your eyes on the one who starts and finishes.

08-13.title: Psalm 59
08-13.line: I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning.
08-13.meaning: sing in the morning, even quietly.

08-14.title: Proverbs 31
08-14.line: she openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.

08-15.title: John Wesley
08-15.line: the best of all is, God is with us.
08-15.meaning: John Wesley's reported words near the end of his life in 1791.

08-16.title: Psalm 112
08-16.line: he shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
08-16.meaning: a steady heart in uncertain news.

08-17.title: Isaiah 35
08-17.line: the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

08-18.title: Psalm 138
08-18.line: in the day when I cried thou answeredst me.

08-19.title: Matthew 13
08-19.line: the kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed.

08-20.title: Psalm 145
08-20.line: great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised.

08-21.title: Colossians 4
08-21.line: let your speech be alway with grace, seasoned with salt.
08-21.meaning: gracious words with a little flavor.

08-22.title: Be Still, My Soul
08-22.line: be still, my soul: the Lord is on thy side.
08-22.meaning: a German hymn set to Sibelius's 'Finlandia'. a calming line for a busy day.
08-22.source: Katharina von Schlegel, Be Still, My Soul (tr. Jane Borthwick, 1855)

08-23.title: Psalm 9
08-23.line: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart.

08-24.title: Matthew 5
08-24.line: blessed are the meek: for they shall inherit the earth.

08-25.title: Isaiah 12
08-25.line: I will trust, and not be afraid.

08-26.title: Psalm 104
08-26.line: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live.

08-27.title: 1 Peter 4
08-27.line: charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

08-28.title: Psalm 33
08-28.line: our soul waiteth for the LORD: he is our help and our shield.

08-29.title: John 21
08-29.meaning: the risen Jesus made breakfast for his friends. share a meal today.

08-30.title: Proverbs 3
08-30.line: in all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
08-30.meaning: include God in every part of the day.

08-31.title: Psalm 57
08-31.line: my heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

09-01.title: Romans 14
09-01.line: let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace.
09-01.meaning: choose peace in one small thing today.

09-02.title: Psalm 68
09-02.line: God setteth the solitary in families.
09-02.meaning: God makes belonging for the lonely.

09-04.title: Psalm 71
09-04.line: thou art my hope, O Lord GOD: thou art my trust from my youth.
09-04.meaning: hope you've had since the beginning.

09-05.title: 2 Corinthians 4
09-05.line: we have this treasure in earthen vessels.
09-05.meaning: ordinary clay pots, carrying treasure. that's us.

09-06.title: Jesus Loves Me
09-06.line: Jesus loves me, this I know, for the Bible tells me so.
09-06.meaning: the first hymn many children learn. still true.
09-06.source: Anna B. Warner, Jesus Loves Me (1860)

09-07.title: Psalm 89
09-07.line: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever.

09-08.title: Isaiah 42
09-08.line: a bruised reed shall he not break.
09-08.meaning: God is gentle with the hurting.

09-09.title: Psalm 95
09-09.line: O come, let us sing unto the LORD.

09-10.title: Luke 5
09-10.meaning: Jesus asked tired fishermen to try once more. try again today.

09-11.title: Psalm 148
09-11.line: praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

09-12.title: James 1
09-12.line: be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only.

09-13.title: Psalm 121
09-13.line: he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
09-13.meaning: God doesn't nap. you can rest.

09-14.title: Hebrews 6
09-14.line: hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast.

09-15.title: Book of Common Prayer
09-15.line: lighten our darkness, we beseech thee, O Lord.
09-15.meaning: a centuries-old evening prayer. say it as the light fades.
09-15.source: Book of Common Prayer (1662), Evening Prayer, Third Collect

09-16.title: Psalm 96
09-16.line: O sing unto the LORD a new song.

09-17.title: Matthew 5
09-17.line: blessed are they which do hunger and thirst after righteousness: for they shall be filled.
09-17.meaning: longing for good is itself blessed.

09-18.title: Psalm 119
09-18.line: the entrance of thy words giveth light.
09-18.meaning: read a verse, let in some light.

09-19.title: John 12
09-19.line: except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone.
09-19.meaning: letting go can lead to new life.

09-20.title: Psalm 126
09-20.line: they that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

09-21.title: 1 Corinthians 15
09-21.line: your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

09-22.title: Psalm 141
09-22.line: let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense.

09-23.title: Now Thank We All Our God
09-23.line: now thank we all our God, with heart and hands and voices.
09-23.meaning: Martin Rinkart wrote this during the Thirty Years' War. thanks in hard times.
09-23.source: Martin Rinkart, Nun danket alle Gott (tr. Catherine Winkworth, 1858)

09-24.title: Psalm 85
09-24.line: mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

09-25.title: John 7
09-25.line: out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

09-26.title: Psalm 16
09-26.line: the lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places.
09-26.meaning: notice the pleasant places in your life.

09-27.title: Ephesians 6
09-27.line: be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

09-28.title: Psalm 119
09-28.line: thou art my hiding place and my shield.

09-29.title: Michaelmas
09-29.line: he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
09-29.meaning: the old feast of St. Michael and all angels. you're not walking alone.

09-30.title: Isaiah 52
09-30.line: how beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings.
09-30.meaning: carry good news to someone today.

10-01.title: Psalm 139
10-01.line: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.
10-01.meaning: God sees just as well in the dark.

10-02.title: Fiona Macleod
10-02.line: deep peace of the running wave to you.
10-02.meaning: an old Gaelic-style blessing of peace. pass it to someone.
10-02.source: Fiona Macleod (William Sharp), 'Deep Peace' (adapted from the Gaelic)

10-03.title: Matthew 26
10-03.meaning: two simple words for a tempting moment.

10-04.title: St. Francis of Assisi
10-04.line: praised be you, my Lord, with all your creatures.
10-04.meaning: Francis sang to God through sun, moon, water and fire. notice one living thing today and say thank you.
10-04.source: Francis of Assisi, Canticle of the Creatures (paraphrase)

10-07.title: Psalm 67
10-07.line: God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us.
10-07.meaning: an old blessing for everyone you love.

10-08.title: Mark 4
10-08.line: first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.
10-08.meaning: growth happens in stages. be patient.

10-09.title: Psalm 90
10-09.line: establish thou the work of our hands upon us.
10-09.meaning: a prayer for your work today.

10-10.title: Philippians 4
10-10.line: I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

10-11.title: Psalm 116
10-11.line: return unto thy rest, O my soul.

10-12.title: All Things Bright and Beautiful
10-12.line: all things bright and beautiful, all creatures great and small.
10-12.meaning: Cecil Frances Alexander wrote this for children. look for one small creature today and say thanks.
10-12.source: Cecil Frances Alexander, All Things Bright and Beautiful (1848)

10-13.title: Numbers 6
10-13.line: the LORD bless thee, and keep thee.
10-13.meaning: one of the oldest blessings in the Bible. say it over someone.

10-14.title: Numbers 6
10-14.line: the LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee.

10-15.title: Numbers 6
10-15.line: the LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

10-16.title: Psalm 150
10-16.line: let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD.

10-17.title: Psalm 63
10-17.line: in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

10-18.title: Isaiah 58
10-18.line: thou shalt be like a watered garden.

10-19.title: Psalm 86
10-19.line: thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy.

10-20.title: Galatians 6
10-20.line: let us not be weary in well doing.

10-21.title: Exodus 33
10-21.line: my presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest.

10-22.title: Deuteronomy 33
10-22.line: the eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms.

10-24.title: 1 Samuel 16
10-24.line: man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart.

10-25.title: 1 Kings 19
10-25.line: after the fire a still small voice.
10-25.meaning: God is often in the quiet.

10-26.title: Nehemiah 8
10-26.line: the joy of the LORD is your strength.

10-27.title: Esther 4
10-27.line: who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?
10-27.meaning: you may be here for a reason.

10-28.title: Job 12
10-28.line: ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee.
10-28.meaning: creation has lessons. watch an animal today.

10-29.title: Job 19
10-29.line: I know that my redeemer liveth.
10-29.meaning: Job held on to this in his darkest days.

10-30.title: Job 38
10-30.line: when the morning stars sang together.

10-31.title: All Hallows' Eve and Reformation Day
10-31.line: the just shall live by faith.
10-31.meaning: on this day in 1517, Martin Luther posted his theses. this verse lit his heart. tonight also begins All Saints.

11-01.title: All Saints' Day
11-01.line: we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses.
11-01.meaning: all who have gone before in faith are cheering us on. who do you remember today?

11-02.title: All Souls' Day
11-02.line: blessed are they that mourn: for they shall be comforted.
11-02.meaning: a day to remember loved ones who have died. say a name you miss.

11-03.title: Genesis 1
11-03.line: God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good.

11-04.title: Genesis 9
11-04.line: I do set my bow in the cloud.

11-05.title: Genesis 12
11-05.line: I will bless thee... and thou shalt be a blessing.

11-06.title: Genesis 50
11-06.line: ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good.
11-06.meaning: God can bring good out of hard things.

11-07.title: Exodus 3
11-07.line: the place whereon thou standest is holy ground.
11-07.meaning: where you stand right now can be holy.

11-08.title: Exodus 14
11-08.line: the LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
11-08.meaning: sometimes the task is to be still.

11-09.title: Exodus 15
11-09.line: the LORD is my strength and song.

11-10.title: Leviticus 19
11-10.line: the stranger that dwelleth with you... thou shalt love him as thyself.

11-11.title: Deuteronomy 6
11-11.line: thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart.
11-11.meaning: all of it. not a corner.

11-12.title: Deuteronomy 1
11-12.line: the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son.
11-12.meaning: carried the whole way, like a child in a parent's arms.

11-13.title: Joshua 24
11-13.line: as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.

11-14.title: 2 Samuel 22
11-14.line: the LORD will lighten my darkness.

11-15.title: 1 Kings 3
11-15.line: give therefore thy servant an understanding heart.
11-15.meaning: Solomon asked for wisdom, not riches.

11-16.title: 1 Chronicles 16
11-16.line: seek the LORD and his strength, seek his face continually.
11-16.meaning: keep looking for God, a little every day.

11-17.title: Proverbs 11
11-17.line: he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
11-17.meaning: refresh someone, and you'll be refreshed.

11-18.title: Proverbs 12
11-18.line: a good word maketh it glad.
11-18.meaning: one good word can lift a heavy heart.

11-19.title: Proverbs 25
11-19.line: a word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
11-19.meaning: the right word at the right time is precious.

11-20.title: Proverbs 18
11-20.line: there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

11-21.title: Ecclesiastes 3
11-21.line: he hath made every thing beautiful in his time.

11-23.title: Ecclesiastes 11
11-23.line: cast thy bread upon the waters: for thou shalt find it after many days.

11-24.title: Song of Solomon 2
11-24.line: the flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing of birds is come.

11-25.title: Isaiah 6
11-25.meaning: a willing heart is enough to start.

11-26.title: Isaiah 11
11-26.line: the wolf also shall dwell with the lamb.
11-26.meaning: a picture of peace still to come.

11-27.title: Isaiah 30
11-27.line: this is the way, walk ye in it.

11-28.title: Isaiah 49
11-28.line: I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands.

11-29.title: Isaiah 55
11-29.line: ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters.

11-30.title: St. Andrew
11-30.meaning: Andrew's first move was to bring his brother. who could you bring along to something good?

12-01.title: Isaiah 55
12-01.line: my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways.
12-01.meaning: God sees farther. that can be a relief.

12-02.title: Isaiah 66
12-02.line: as one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you.

12-03.title: Jeremiah 6
12-03.line: ask for the old paths... and ye shall find rest for your souls.
12-03.meaning: old wisdom can bring new rest.

12-04.title: Jeremiah 17
12-04.line: he shall be as a tree planted by the waters.
12-04.meaning: deep roots hold through dry seasons.

12-05.title: Jeremiah 29
12-05.line: I know the thoughts that I think toward you... thoughts of peace, and not of evil.
12-05.meaning: God's thoughts toward you are peace.

12-06.title: St. Nicholas
12-06.line: let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth.
12-06.meaning: the real Nicholas was a bishop known for secret gifts. the best gifts don't need credit.

12-07.title: Jeremiah 31
12-07.line: I have loved thee with an everlasting love.

12-08.title: Ezekiel 36
12-08.line: a new heart also will I give you.
12-08.meaning: a new heart is a gift.

12-09.title: Joel 2
12-09.line: your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions.

12-10.title: Amos 5
12-10.line: let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.

12-11.title: Habakkuk 3
12-11.line: yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will joy in the God of my salvation.
12-11.meaning: joy, even when the fields are bare.

12-12.title: Zechariah 4
12-12.line: not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, saith the LORD.

12-13.title: Zechariah 4
12-13.line: who hath despised the day of small things?

12-14.title: Matthew 4
12-14.line: man shall not live by bread alone.

12-15.title: Matthew 4
12-15.line: follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
12-15.meaning: an invitation that changed some fishermen's lives.

12-16.title: Matthew 5
12-16.line: blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

12-17.title: Matthew 5
12-17.line: love your enemies, bless them that curse you.
12-17.meaning: the hardest command. start with a quiet blessing.

12-18.title: Matthew 6
12-18.line: when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray.

12-19.title: Matthew 6
12-19.line: our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
12-19.meaning: the prayer Jesus taught. say it slowly today.

12-20.title: Matthew 6
12-20.line: give us this day our daily bread.
12-20.meaning: just today's bread. enough for today.

12-21.title: Matthew 6
12-21.line: forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors.

12-22.title: Matthew 10
12-22.line: freely ye have received, freely give.

12-23.title: Matthew 11
12-23.line: my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.
12-23.meaning: the way of Jesus is lighter than we fear.

12-24.title: Christmas Eve
12-24.line: there was no room for them in the inn.
12-24.meaning: tonight we wait by the manger. make a little room in your heart.

12-25.title: Christmas Day
12-25.line: unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour.
12-25.meaning: merry Christmas. God came close, as a child small enough to hold.

12-26.title: St. Stephen
12-26.line: Lord, lay not this sin to their charge.
12-26.meaning: the day after Christmas remembers Stephen, who forgave even as he died. 'Good King Wenceslas' looked out on this feast.

12-27.title: St. John
12-27.line: little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed.
12-27.meaning: the beloved disciple's simple advice. let love show in something you do.

12-28.title: Holy Innocents
12-28.line: suffer little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me.
12-28.meaning: a day to remember children who suffer, and to hold them in prayer.

12-29.title: Matthew 17
12-29.line: if ye have faith as a grain of mustard seed... nothing shall be impossible unto you.

12-30.title: Matthew 18
12-30.line: except ye be converted, and become as little children.

12-31.title: Watch Night
12-31.line: hitherto hath the LORD helped us.
12-31.meaning: Samuel set up a stone and named it Ebenezer: so far, God has helped. look back on this year with thanks.

2026-11-22.title: Christ the King Sunday
2026-11-22.line: the King of kings, and Lord of lords.
2026-11-22.meaning: the last Sunday of the church year: a king who served and washed feet.

2026-11-26.title: Thanksgiving
2026-11-26.line: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
2026-11-26.meaning: happy Thanksgiving. name three things you're grateful for at the table.

2026-11-29.title: First Sunday of Advent
2026-11-29.meaning: a new church year begins. Advent is four weeks of hopeful waiting. light the first candle.
2026-11-29.source: Veni, Emmanuel (tr. John Mason Neale, 1851, altered)

2026-12-06.title: Second Sunday of Advent
2026-12-06.line: prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
2026-12-06.meaning: John the Baptist's call. clear one small path this week.

2026-12-13.title: Third Sunday of Advent
2026-12-13.meaning: the joy Sunday: the pink candle. joy is near.

2026-12-20.title: Fourth Sunday of Advent
2026-12-20.line: they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us.

2026-12-27.title: Hark! The Herald Angels Sing
2026-12-27.line: hark! the herald angels sing, Glory to the new-born King.
2026-12-27.meaning: Christmas lasts twelve days. keep singing.
2026-12-27.source: Charles Wesley, Hark! The Herald Angels Sing (1739)

2027-01-10.title: The Baptism of the Lord
2027-01-10.line: thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
2027-01-10.meaning: God's love came before Jesus did any public work. you are loved before you do anything too.

2027-02-07.title: Transfiguration Sunday
2027-02-07.line: Lord, it is good for us to be here.
2027-02-07.meaning: the last Sunday before Lent, when many churches remember the mountaintop.

2027-02-09.title: Shrove Tuesday
2027-02-09.meaning: pancake day: a feast before the Lenten fast begins tomorrow.

2027-02-10.title: Ash Wednesday
2027-02-10.line: dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.
2027-02-10.meaning: Lent begins: forty days to slow down and come back to God.

2027-02-14.title: First Sunday in Lent
2027-02-14.line: Jesus was led up of the spirit into the wilderness.
2027-02-14.meaning: Jesus spent forty days in the wilderness. Lent is our forty days. (love is on the calendar today too.)

2027-02-21.title: Second Sunday in Lent
2027-02-21.line: let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
2027-02-21.meaning: Lent asks what we can let go of, to follow more freely.

2027-02-28.title: Third Sunday in Lent
2027-02-28.line: whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst.
2027-02-28.meaning: Jesus met a woman at a well and offered living water.

2027-03-07.title: Fourth Sunday in Lent
2027-03-07.line: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
2027-03-07.meaning: halfway through Lent, a man born blind sees. some churches call this Mothering Sunday.

2027-03-14.title: Fifth Sunday in Lent
2027-03-14.meaning: Jesus calls his friend out of the tomb. Easter is getting close.

2027-03-21.title: Palm Sunday
2027-03-21.line: Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
2027-03-21.meaning: Holy Week begins with palms and praise. walk with Jesus this week.

2027-03-25.title: Maundy Thursday
2027-03-25.line: this do in remembrance of me.
2027-03-25.meaning: the Last Supper and the washing of feet. 'maundy' comes from the new commandment: love one another.

2027-03-26.title: Good Friday
2027-03-26.line: Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.
2027-03-26.meaning: the day Jesus died on the cross, forgiving even then. a day for quiet.

2027-03-27.title: Holy Saturday
2027-03-27.meaning: the quiet day of waiting at the tomb. hope holds its breath.

2027-03-28.title: Easter Sunday
2027-03-28.line: he is not here: for he is risen, as he said.
2027-03-28.meaning: Christ is risen! the brightest day of the Christian year.

2027-03-29.title: Easter Monday
2027-03-29.line: Christ the Lord is risen today, Alleluia!
2027-03-29.meaning: Easter is a season, not just a day. fifty days of joy begin.
2027-03-29.source: Charles Wesley, Christ the Lord Is Risen Today (1739)

2027-05-02.title: Orthodox Easter (Pascha)
2027-05-02.line: Christ is risen! He is risen indeed!
2027-05-02.meaning: Orthodox Christians celebrate Easter today. a greeting shared by Christians around the world.

2027-05-06.title: Ascension Day
2027-05-06.line: he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight.
2027-05-06.meaning: forty days after Easter. Jesus returns to the Father and promises the Spirit.

2027-05-16.title: Pentecost
2027-05-16.line: they were all filled with the Holy Ghost.
2027-05-16.meaning: the Spirit came like wind and fire, and the Church was born. ask for the Spirit today.

2027-05-23.title: Trinity Sunday
2027-05-23.line: the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God... be with you all.
2027-05-23.meaning: one God, Father, Son and Spirit: a communion of love. Paul's blessing for you.

2027-11-21.title: Christ the King Sunday
2027-11-21.meaning: the last Sunday of the church year. a kingdom of mercy and peace.

2027-11-25.title: Thanksgiving
2027-11-25.line: we gather together to ask the Lord's blessing.
2027-11-25.meaning: happy Thanksgiving. an old Dutch hymn, sung at many Thanksgiving tables. name what you're grateful for.
2027-11-25.source: Wilt heden nu treden (tr. Theodore Baker, 1894)

2027-11-28.title: First Sunday of Advent
2027-11-28.line: the night is far spent, the day is at hand.
2027-11-28.meaning: a new church year begins. wake up to hope.

2027-12-05.title: Second Sunday of Advent
2027-12-05.line: come, thou long expected Jesus, born to set thy people free.
2027-12-05.meaning: Charles Wesley's Advent hymn. waiting with hope.
2027-12-05.source: Charles Wesley, Come, Thou Long Expected Jesus (1744)

2027-12-12.title: Third Sunday of Advent
2027-12-12.meaning: the joy Sunday: the pink candle. he's near.

2027-12-19.title: Fourth Sunday of Advent
2027-12-19.line: let every heart prepare him room.
2027-12-19.meaning: Isaac Watts's 'Joy to the World'. make room this week.
2027-12-19.source: Isaac Watts, Joy to the World (1719)

2027-12-26.title: Silent Night
2027-12-26.line: silent night, holy night, all is calm, all is bright.
2027-12-26.meaning: first sung in an Austrian village church on Christmas Eve, 1818. the twelve days of Christmas have begun.
2027-12-26.source: Joseph Mohr, Stille Nacht (tr. John F. Young, 1859)
